# Carlos Alejandro Coronado Obregon

Carlos Alejandro Coronado Obregon, also known as Alejandro Coronado and Alex Coronado, is a Senior Software Engineer, AI Solutions Engineer, and Solutions Architect based in San Luis Potosi, Mexico.
